decisions.reason: Bleaching tray blanks are a low-cost consumable in the core thermoforming range, and the missing website observations for 2020 to 2021 do not show a failed option, so keeping it open costs little.
A PETG thermoforming blank fits steady lab demand and the existing production base, so its holding cost is minimal and abandoning it brings little benefit.

The UV-curing lacquer had weaker visibility from the start, but it is cheap to keep listed as digital printing workflows grow, so the option stays open, though it is the most likely candidate for pruning.
The intraoral contrast spray supports the firm's strategic shift to intraoral scanning and digital workflows, so it is an option worth holding while that market expands.

Custom hearing protection shares the earmold production base and has occupational growth potential, but the earlier withdrawal of the related earmold line suggests some risk, so it is kept at moderate drop probability.
